title: Design Studio Selections Training Note: Relief on Consultation Fees When Options Are Ordered Promptly
content:
**Q. Can an order placed soon after an appointment lower that appointment's consultation fee on a Design Studio Selections file?**
Yes. The order relief rate is set by the change order whose option lines were added most recently on the file, counted in calendar days from the billed appointment to the date those lines were added:

- where they were added on the appointment date or up to 7 days after it and the option lines added under that change order total 5000.00 or more, the fee is charged at 50 percent;
- where they were added on the appointment date or up to 7 days after it and the option lines added under that change order total less than 5000.00, the fee is charged at 75 percent;
- otherwise the fee is charged at 100 percent.

**Q. Which records are read?**
The option line entries on the design ledger: the change order number carried by the most recently added option lines, the date those lines were added, and the total price of every option line added under that change order number; and the date of the billed appointment.

**Q. Where are the edges of the window?**

| Lines added (days after the billed appointment) | Total under that change order | Order relief rate |
|---|---|---|
| Same day (0) | 5000.00 | 50 percent |
| 7 | 4999.99 | 75 percent |
| 8 | 12000.00 | 100 percent |
| Before the appointment date | Any | 100 percent |

**Q. What does a total of exactly 5000.00 give?**
5000.00 is "5000.00 or more", so 50 percent within the window.
